text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went to a ramen shop, I happened to spot
Narita Brian and Biwa Hayahide there.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Thanks for the food.
It was good."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I'll be on my way.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Are you leaving already?
You really ought to rest a bit after eating...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, it's you.
We just happened to run into each other, that's all."

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh, welcome!
Let me know whenever you're ready to order!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Right now, it comes with "Extra Specialty Chashu" on the house!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"That stuff is delicious.
Every single bite just bursts with juice."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this leaning a bit too heavily toward meat...?
You even moved all the vegetables that were on top over to my plate.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...It's probably just your imagination.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Imagination, nothing! I saw you.
You need to eat more vegetables, too...!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Ah ha ha! But if you like it,
then I'm happy!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
"If you like it that much,
how about some extra chashu on the house?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Are you sure?
choice_data_list: Why not take them up on the offer?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Eat too much, and it'll slow down your movements.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I think that's a wise decision.
And good advice from you, too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch, my sis is meddlesome about every little thing,
or rather, she acts too much like a big sister.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?
Still, the fact remains that you are the older sister—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Brian!
Don't run on the way back! Take it slow!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While warmly watching the sisters' exchange,
I went ahead and ordered the ramen with extra chashu pork.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Until every last bite is gone!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
How reckless can you girls be...!
Wait, are you really fine with just chashu?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I can keep going.
Pops, give me an extra serving of chashu.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
......Phew.
That was a bigger catch than I imagined.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That shopkeeper was so moved by how much you ate,
he kept bringing out one refill after another...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Are you all right, Brian?
That clearly exceeds a sensible portion size..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
No problem... I'm going to run
and burn it off right away... anyway...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian fully enjoyed the chashu pork, but ended up feeling a bit bloated from overeating...
